style: Painterly dark-fantasy game art, ancient Chinese folklore, muted desaturated browns and greys with a dark crimson cloth accent, soft light from the upper left, clean readable silhouettes, crisp edges, no outline glow.

armor.prompt: Edit the attached parts sheet. Keep every piece in EXACTLY the same position, size, outline and pose; do not move, rescale or redraw the fur. Only add armour on top: a dented old bronze shoulder pauldron and chest plate strapped over the torso piece (piece 2), a bronze bracer around the forearm piece (piece 4), and a bronze knee guard on the thigh piece (piece 5). Head, upper arm and shin stay unchanged. Armour stays inside each piece's silhouette, except the pauldron may stick out a little above the shoulder. Plain flat pure white background, no text.
